name: image-theme
description: Turns a picture you choose into your Claude theme: the picture becomes the app background, softly veiled with a frosted column behind the chat, and the theme colours are taken from it. /image-theme opens a file picker.

veil.title: Veil (0 to 0.8)
veil.description: How much of the theme's page colour is laid over the picture so text stays readable. 0 shows the picture as it is.

frostedColumn.title: Frosted column
frostedColumn.description: Blur and tint the middle of the picture, behind the chat, fading out at both sides (Windows).
